_comment: Built-in: the code is compiled into the app; this manifest exists so the feature installs, enables and uninstalls through the same path as a community plugin. permissions are DISCLOSURE, shown in the install dialog — unlike a script plugin there is no sandbox enforcing them, because this code is part of the app. Keep them truthful.
name: Command Palette
author: Octo Jotter
description: A quick-action search for jumping to notes and running commands.
capability: Reads note titles to offer them as jump targets.
